title: Vehicle access from the lowest-order available street
text: Where multiple accesses are available, vehicle access to on site car parking spaces to be provided via the lowest available street in the hierarchy, as follows: i. where available, from a right-of-way or communal street available for lawful use to access the relevant site and which is trafficable and drained from the property boundary to a constructed street; or ii. from the secondary street or primary street where no right-of-way or communal street exists.

replaces.note: corner lots R25 and below may take access from the primary street

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.7.1. 'Multiple accesses available' is modelled as any of a ROW, communal street or secondary street. A ROW or communal street counts only where lawful, trafficable and drained to a constructed street (inside the applicant's answer). Corner-lot flexibility now extends to R25 and below.

verified.note: Wording confirmed. 'Where multiple accesses are available' is modelled as any of a ROW, communal street or secondary street (interpretation).
